title: Researchers used canary credentials in requests to AI routers like OpenRouter and Vercel, even under "ZDR" policies, and saw "privacy" often broken, keys stolen (Dan Goodin/Ars Technica)
summary: Dan Goodin / Ars Technica: Researchers used canary credentials in requests to AI routers like OpenRouter and Vercel, even under “ZDR” policies, and saw “privacy” often broken, keys stolen — Researchers planted 2 million digital tripwires in requests sent through a sprawling network of AI services …
